name: netdata-cloud
footnotes: Same binary as the self-hosted row, claimed to Netdata Cloud. ML anomaly detection stays at its default (on).
kickstart's default channel is nightly; installed with --stable-channel so the version is a release readers can reproduce.
Anonymous telemetry and the daily updater timer stay at their defaults; the updater's unit is counted with the agent.

Nearly all of this row's inbound bytes are a steady 8 KB/s from Netdata's go.d plugin polling the box's two Docker containers every second over the Docker bridge (Valkey INFO is about 6.3 KB, nginx about 1 KB), traffic that never leaves the box. The headline network figure for this row (bytes out) does not include it.

Ubuntu's unattended-upgrades ran once during the cycle (about 06:30 UTC) on the stock image and, with the other services linked against the upgraded libraries, restarted this agent several times within a few minutes. The restarts fall in the idle window; the idle medians are unaffected, the cycle's totals include them.
